title: CYBRIK CloudEvents-style cross-product envelope v1
description: CloudEvents 1.0-style envelope with CYBRIK extension attributes (ADR-0006 E1/E6/E7). Extension attributes are SCALAR per the CloudEvents type system (String/Integer/Boolean/URI/Timestamp); structured data marking and delegation detail live in the typed `data` payload, while scalar routing/filtering copies live as extension attributes. Envelope identity/tenant/marking attributes are written ONLY by authenticated service code; model output can never populate them (ADR-0006). Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED.

specversion.description: CloudEvents spec version. Pinned to 1.0 for this envelope profile.

id.description: CloudEvents id. Unique per (source, id). Consumers dedup on (source,id) for idempotency (strategy 05 §7).

source.description: CloudEvents source (URI-reference). Identifies the producing context, e.g. '/cybrik/soc' or '/cybrik/fabric/control-plane'. Not an operational endpoint.

type.description: CloudEvents type. MUST follow CYBRIK naming: cybrik.<product>.<entity>.<action>.v<major> (ADR-0006 E7).

subject.description: CloudEvents subject. Primary entity the event concerns within source scope.

dataschema.description: CloudEvents dataschema: identifier ($id) of the JSON Schema that `data` conforms to. Enables version negotiation (ADR-0001).

tenantid.description: CYBRIK extension (scalar). Advisory tenant tag for routing/partitioning; the authoritative tenant is derived from the producer's authenticated identity. Consumers MUST reject cross-tenant mismatch (ADR-0006; strategy 05 §11.1).

marking.description: CYBRIK extension (scalar). Compact handling label mirroring the structured marking in `data`, e.g. 'TLP:AMBER/internal'. The authoritative, structured marking is cybrik.data-marking in the payload; this scalar exists only for bus-level filtering.

traceparent.description: CYBRIK extension = CloudEvents Distributed Tracing extension. Required for operational cross-product workflow events; created at the boundary when absent (ADR-0006 E6).

tracestate.description: CYBRIK extension = CloudEvents Distributed Tracing extension.

correlationid.description: CYBRIK extension (scalar). Correlation semantics are defined per event class (ADR-0006 E6); presence rules are enforced by each event's payload schema, not globally.

causationid.description: CYBRIK extension (scalar). Id of the event/request that directly caused this one. Required for derived events; absent for legitimate root events (ADR-0006 E6).

investigationid.description: CYBRIK extension (scalar). Required ONLY for investigation-scoped events; absent/optional otherwise (ADR-0006 E6).

delegationref.description: CYBRIK extension (scalar). Digest reference to the digest-bound delegation chain authorizing this event's action (ADR-0006 E3). The full chain is NOT inlined in the envelope; it is resolved control-side and embedded in receipts.

data.description: CloudEvents data. The versioned CYBRIK payload; its schema is identified by `dataschema` and `type`.
